question: Find the value of m for which it satisfies( (21)/(8) )¹² times ( (8)/(21) )¹⁴ times ( (21)/(8) )¹⁴ = ( (8)/(21) )⁹m ⁺ ²⁰
solution:
**Given:**

( (21)/(8) )¹² times ( (8)/(21) )¹⁴ times ( (21)/(8) )¹⁴ = ( (8)/(21) )⁹m ⁺ ²⁰

**Formula used:**

a^m times a^n = am⁺ⁿ

( (a)/(b) )^n = ( (b)/(a) )⁻ⁿ

**Calculation:**

LHS: ( (21)/(8) )¹² times ( (8)/(21) )¹⁴ times ( (21)/(8) )¹⁴

⇒ ( (21)/(8) )¹² ⁺ ¹⁴ times ( (8)/(21) )¹⁴

⇒ ( (21)/(8) )²⁶ times ( (21)/(8) )⁻¹⁴

⇒ ( (21)/(8) )²⁶ ⁻ ¹⁴ = ( (21)/(8) )¹² 

Now express all powers in base ( (8)/(21) ):

⇒ ( (21)/(8) )¹² = ( (8)/(21) )⁻¹² 

RHS = ( (8)/(21) )⁹m ⁺ ²⁰

Now equating powers:

⇒ −12 = 9m + 20

⇒ 9m = −32

⇒ m = −32/9 

**∴ The value of m is −(32)/(9)**
